summary: All 27 occurrences checked. Active change/exchange combines an ordinary object, a b-marked exchanged item, or an indexed person with a b-marked counterpart. Ring exchange can also have ʕam ḥḏoḏe as partner.

Objectless active mbadli (PrS 17/19) marks iterative alternation; this differs formally from ruḥo-reflexive disguising and from Detransitive change. The one-token subsense remains open to an elliptical-object analysis.

Detransitive change covers situation, attitudes, officeholder and shape. At 3/65 the skin-colour comparison can describe variation across people, not a temporal transformation of one person. At 8/11 Part. Pass. describes changeability, already present in the entry.

The supplied eye-shape quotation cites both 3/21 and 3/65, but only 3/21 supplies that wording. The new 3/65 example preserves the different skin-colour clause; detach its misleading citation from the old eye-shape text.

No duplicate examples added for 23/45, 24/35–36, 24/155, 24/201, 26/110, 26/140, 62/261 or the established Detransitive witnesses. The existing clothing passage and PrS 36/33 overlap despite different legacy reference formats; no unverified citation conversion made.
